content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients carry a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept, domain_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) LIKE '%type 2 diabetes mellitus%'
  AND domain_id = 'Condition'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept = 'S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name
LIMIT 20;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 20 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, standard_concept, domain_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) IN ('type 2 diabetes mellitus','diabetes mellitus type 2')
   OR (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%type 2 diabetes mellitus%' AND concept_name NOT LIKE '%due to%')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(concept_name) = 'type 2 diabetes mellitus' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, standard_concept DESC, concept_name;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826
);

content.text: 116,537 distinct patients carry a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes, using OMOP condition records under the standard SNOMED concept `201826` (“Type 2 diabetes mellitus”) and its descendants.
